narrative.details:
I'm glad to hear you're aiding us in our attack on Ahn'Qiraj, adventurer.  I can make you a protective item that'll be of assistance in the fight against our enemy, champion.

I shall need a Qiraji drape, which I'll resize for you of course.  I'll also need idols and scarabs which I'll use to create a suitable clasp.

I promise you won't be disappointed.
narrative.objectives: Bring 1 Qiraji Regal Drape, 2 Vermillion Idols, 5 Silver Scarabs and 5 Bone Scarabs to Keyl Swiftclaw in Silithus.  You must also obtain Revered reputation with Cenarion Circle to complete this quest.
narrative.offerRewardText:
Ah yes... this drape is immaculate.

Take this cloak, adventurer. May it protect you from the foul magic of the Qiraji.
narrative.requestItemsText: Did you bring the materials for the cloak, adventurer?
